_doc: Pervežimų grafikas — single source for ticker, board, timetables, table, stubs and next-line ({{grafikas:*}} placeholders; production = ACF Options repeater + [sgp_grafikas] shortcode). Dates are ISO (year assigned from the 2026-09-23 crawl — client to confirm). render_today = the date the static build treats as 'today' (keeps the build deterministic); sgp.js recomputes everything client-side when the visitor's Europe/Vilnius date differs (or ?siandien=YYYY-MM-DD). Outbound rows dial the LT line; inbound rows dial the destination-country line (dizaino-sistema.md §0.1 #6, §6.0).
note: Tikslų išvykimo laiką ir paėmimo vietą suderinsime telefonu.
